description:
Salad turns downtime into downloads. Run Salad whenever you're away from the keys to score games, gift cards, subscriptions, DLC, and more at the Salad Storefront.


Clearer machine setup notifications: they name the root cause (virtualization, Windows, or WSL), show up sooner, clear once the issue is fixed, and no longer blame your machine for problems on Salad's side. The NVIDIA driver notification now links to a fix guide.
Download speed now shows in Mbps, the same unit internet plans use.
Fixes container workloads getting stuck starting or downloading, or showing the wrong status.
Improves reliability when container workloads are started, restarted, or stopped.
General maintenance and reliability improvements.
